What to expect in your first visit

We want you to feel at home from the moment you arrive. Our worship is simple, Scripture-centered, and full of gratitude. Come as you are, and bring your questions.

Plan your visit

Before you arrive View all FAQs

Is there parking available?
Yes — free on-site parking at 1576 Fairview Ave. A greeter at the main entrance will point you the right way.
What should I wear?
Whatever you’re comfortable in. You’ll see everything from jeans to suits. Come as you are.
Are children and youth welcome?
Absolutely. Ask a greeter about children’s programs and Pathfinders for ages 10–15.
How long is the service?
Sabbath School is followed by worship at 11:00 AM. Plan on about two hours in total.
